subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: Should workspace discovery silently omit hooks whose package.json or HOOK.md exceeds 1 MiB, or log a recovery-oriented warning?
rationale: The fixed limit can disable a previously discoverable hook after upgrade; both warning and silent-skip behavior are technically possible, so repository intent is required for the compatibility contract.

options.title: Warn and skip oversized hooks
options.body: Continue discovery while logging the rejected metadata file and 1 MiB limit so users can repair the hook.

options.title: Silently skip oversized hooks
options.body: Treat size rejection like the existing missing, unreadable, or malformed metadata cases.

recommendation.title: Warn and skip oversized hooks
recommendation.body: Continue discovery while logging the rejected metadata file and 1 MiB limit so users can repair the hook.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor introduced the shared bounded descriptor seam and most directly owns the current implementation pattern, though hook-specific UX ownership is less certain.
